observed_primary_claim_paraphrase: For promotional online videos, displaying the ad disclosure only at the start can be insufficient, since viewers may enter midway. Clear disclosure throughout may be desirable. Per-case judgment.
limitations_counterclaim_and_transferabi: This is a legal compliance rule, not evidence of app demo-video conversion gains. Japanese statutory context only.

observed_primary_claim_paraphrase: Japanese regulation covers undisclosed business-sponsored reviews/influencer promotions in addition to ordinary advertising. Honest personal opinion without business control differs from ad.
limitations_counterclaim_and_transferabi: Same originating government authority as N896_S001, NOT an independent corroborating origin. Not an estimate of ad effectiveness.

observed_primary_claim_paraphrase: US rule prohibits fake or falsely attributed reviews, and purchased positive/negative reviews. Incentives cannot be conditioned on favorable sentiment; some neutral incentives may be allowed with disclosure.
limitations_counterclaim_and_transferabi: US jurisdiction, not Japanese law. Measures permissible practices not purchase conversion.

checked_original_section: People-first content; Search engine first content
observed_primary_claim_paraphrase: Google Search recommends original, credible, people-first material. Bulk automated writing for rankings without value is a negative signal. Does not promise ranks or traffic from a particular tool.
limitations_counterclaim_and_transferabi: Google ranking guidance, not observed traffic for this future application and not an independent measure of conversion.

observed_primary_claim_paraphrase: Japan Digital Agency revised the government generative-AI procurement/use guidance to version 2.0 on 2026-06-12. Its materials include procurement and contracting checklists.
limitations_counterclaim_and_transferabi: Government procurement example, not all private-company procurement or evidence that a particular AI app is approved. Linked PDF not reviewed in this dataset.

publisher: Brett Gordon et al. / Northwestern Kellogg
observed_primary_claim_paraphrase: Research comparing 15 US Facebook ad experiments (500M user-experiment observations, 1.6B impressions) found observational attribution can differ substantially from randomized causal effects.
limitations_counterclaim_and_transferabi: US historic Facebook experiments not current 2026 Japanese slide-app adverts; advertiser-affiliated coauthors, methodology must be considered. Abstract review, not full paper.

publisher: Judith Chevalier & Dina Mayzlin / Journal of Marketing Research
observed_primary_claim_paraphrase: In historical Amazon and Barnes & Noble book reviews, improved reviews correlated with higher relative book sales; one-star reviews showed stronger effects than five-star for many samples.
limitations_counterclaim_and_transferabi: Books in 2006, not SaaS or 2026 Japan. Selected review sampling and causal interpretation limit external validity; full article restricted.

observed_primary_claim_paraphrase: A randomized study of 3M US Yahoo users found display advertisements increased matched retailer sales 3.6% versus control; a causal effect for that campaign only.
limitations_counterclaim_and_transferabi: Historic US retailer study. Cannot apply 3.6% as expected increase for a Japanese AI presentation app; publisher abstract, not all methods.

publisher: Thomas Frick, Rodrigo Belo, Rahul Telang / Management Science
observed_primary_claim_paraphrase: Randomized retargeting field experiment involved 208538 consumers. Authors found ad-platform CPA bidding favors consumers likely to purchase even where incremental ad effectiveness may be lower, risking firm/platform incentive mismatch.
limitations_counterclaim_and_transferabi: Display-retargeting setting, not Japanese consumer apps. Does not identify users' slide-service willingness-to-pay.
